ai.subtitle: Kwezani mavidiyo anyumba zankhuku kuti muwunike kugawa kwachigulu, kulingalira kuchuluka, ndi mbiri yakusuntha.
ai.prototype_desc: Gawo ili lakuwona mavidiyo limasanthula mavidiyo okhwezedwa. Mavidiyo amasanjidwa munjira yanthawi yeniyeni pagawo lachiwiri.
ai.select_view: Sankhani gulu pamwambapa kuti muyambe kuwunika mavidiyo a AI.
ai.archived_desc: Zolemba zamavidiyo ndi ziwerengero zimasungidwa pagulu lililonse.
ai.or_click: kapena dinani kuti mufufuze mafayilo a pa chipangizo (MP4, WebM)
ai.processing: Kukonza zithunzi ndi YOLOv8 neural net…
ai.awaiting_desc: Kwezani vidiyo yatsopano kapena sankhani mbiri yakale kuchokera pambali kuti muwone zolosera za AI.
ai.note: Zindikirani: Dongosolo loyerekeza mavidiyo likufanizira kuwona kwavidiyo motsutsana ndi magawo a gulu (kukula kwa gulu kuchotsa zolemba zaimfa zatsiku ndi tsiku). Chidziwitso chayikidwa pamzere wachidziwitso chadongosolo.

audio.title: Zidziwitso Za Mawu
audio.subtitle: Laibulale yamawu isanthula mayankho owopsa amakhalidwe ankhuku ndimayendedwe amawu.
audio.research_desc: Dongosolo ili limasewera zizindikiro zosonyeza kuzunzika. Mayikolofoni apanthawi yeniyeni adzakonzedwa Mu Gawo Lachiwiri.
audio.cough_desc: Manambala otsika amachititsa kuti ML model ipereke chidziwitso chakutsokomola pafupipafupi.
audio.chirp_desc: Sinthani mulingo wa zotheka zamavuto pamawu atali otentha.
audio.select_desc: Sankhani mbiri kuchokera kulaibulale kuti musewere mawu opangidwa, fufuzani pafupipafupi ndikuwona malangizo azaumoyo.

batches.no_archived: Palibe magulu osungidwa. Magulu achangu adzaonekera kuno akatsekedwa.

landing.hero_desc: Kupatsa mphamvu alimi ang'onoang'ono a nkhuku kudera lonse la Africa kugwiritsa ntchito tsamba loyamba lopanda netiweki popanga kaundula kudzera mu YOLOv8, yowerengera zithunzi za magulu ndi kumvetsera kuzunzika kwa mawu ankhuku. Yokonzedwa kuti igwire ntchito modalirika kumidzi kumene netiweki siyabwino kwenikweni.
landing.engineered_desc: Dongosolo lathu limagwirizanitsa mawonekedwe amakono awowunika m'madera omwe kulibe netiweki yolimba pothandiza alimi ang'onoang'ono a mu Africa.
landing.local_desc: Imayendetsedwa kudzera njira yosungira mu IndexedDB. Imalemba kuchuluka kwa chakudya, madzi akumwa, kulemera kwa gulu pamodzi ndi kaundula wa katemera ngakhale netiweki ili yovuta. Imasunga zonse pamzere nikutumiza pa intaneti ikangopezeka.
landing.yolov8_desc: Ikonza mavidiyo pogwiritsa ntchito luso lina lopepuka la YOLOv8. Imawerengera nkhuku, kufalikira poyang'anira dera lazo ndikupereka chidziwitso ngati gulu likusonyeza kusuntha mochepa kapena kubundikira posonyeza kuvutika kwa kutentha kapena kuzizira.
landing.acoustic_health: Kuwunika Kwa Zaumoyo Za Nkhuku kudzera M'mawu
landing.acoustic_desc: Ukatswiri wosanthula ndi makompyuta umayendera komweko pofufuza kumveka kwa mawu a gulu lankhuku. Imawona zovuta zopuma, kutsokomola, kapena mavuto akuzizira kapena kutentha mavuto enieni asanaonekere pa mawonekedwe.
landing.try_classifier: Yesani ukadaulo wa ML yofufuza mawu
landing.test_drive_desc: Gwiritsani ntchito mtundu wosavuta wamagawo a ML athu ofunikira kwambiri komanso maonekedwe azambiri kudzera mu msakatuli womwewu.
landing.open_source_desc: AgriSense AI idadzipereka pantchito zaulere zaukonde polimbikitsa zida zazaulimi. Ukadaulo wathu waukulu wakuwona pakompyuta komanso kagwiridwe koyambirira kogwira popanda intaneti kumapezeka kwaofufuza, mabungwe osati aboma, ndiopanga mapulogalamu otukula tsogolo la ulimi mu Africa.
landing.all_rights: Ufulu onse ndi wotetezedwa. Yokonzedwa kuthandiza ntchito zaulimi kumwera kwa Sahara.
landing.join_beta: Lowani mundondomeko yathu yoyeserera kuti mulembetse gulu lanu pa digito lero.

tour.completed: Ulendo wa famu watha! Mutha kuubwereza nthawi iliyonse kuchokera pa sidebar.

welcome.title: Takulandirani ku AgriSense AI
welcome.content: Onani mwachidule zonse zomwe zili pa bodi ya famu yanu: kuwunika, umoyo wa nkhuku, makamera a AI, mawu, ndalama ndi zosintha. Gwiritsani ntchito mivi kapena mabatani, ndipo Esc kuti mutuluke.

role.title: Famu Yanu ndi Udindo Wanu
role.content: Apa pakuwonetsa famu yomwe mukugwiritsa ntchito ndi mulingo wanu wopeza chidziwitso. Ngati muli ndi mafamu opitilira umodzi, sinthani pogwiritsa ntchito chosankhira famu, ndipo masamba onse adzatsitsimutsidwa.

toolbar.title: Zida za Pamwamba
toolbar.content: Zidziwitso zadzidzidzi, mtundu wa kuwala/mdima, chilankhulo cha Chingerezi kapena Chichewa, mawu okuthandizani pa zikumbutso za mankhwala, ndi chizindikiro cha kugwirizanitsa popanda intaneti zili pano.

sidebar.title: Menyu Yoyendera
sidebar.content: Gawo lililonse lili pafupi: Dashboard, Magulu, Chakudya ndi Madzi, Kukula, Mankhwala, AI, Mawu, Zowerengera, Ndalama ndi Zosintha. Pa kompyuta mutha kuchepetsa; pa foni imatsegulidwa ndi batani la menyu.

alerts.title: Zidziwitso Zogwira Ntchito
alerts.content: Zochitika zofunika monga kuchepa kwa chiwerengero cha nkhuku, phokoso la mavuto, imfa zambiri kapena mankhwala achedwa zimawonekera apa poyamba kuti muchitepo kanthu mwachangu.

quicklinks.title: Njira Zazifupi
quicklinks.content: Njira zazifupi za ntchito za tsiku ndi tsiku: lembani chakudya ndi madzi, kulemera kwa nkhuku, tsegulani makamera a live ndi kuona mankhwala.

batches.title: Magulu a Nkhuku
batches.content: Lembani gulu lililonse la nkhuku ndi mtundu, tsiku loyika ndi chiwerengero. Zolembedwa zonse, kulemera, mankhwala ndi ndalama zimatsatiridwa ndi gulu lomwe mwasankha.

feed.title: Zolemba za Chakudya ndi Madzi
feed.content: Lembani zomwe zadyedwa tsiku ndi tsiku ndikuwona momwe zikuyendera. Tumizani mafayilo a CSV kapena PDF yosindikiza. Zolembedwa popanda intaneti zimagwirizanitsidwa zokha mukalumikizanso.

growth.title: Kukula kwa Nkhuku
growth.content: Lembani kulemera kwa nkhuku ndikuyerekeza kukula kwa gulu lanu ndi cholinga cha mtundu wake, kuti muzindikire mavuto msanga ndikukonza chakudya.

meds.title: Kalendala ya Mankhwala
meds.content: Konzani katemera, mankhwala ndi zowonjezera pogwiritsa ntchito zitsanzo zofulumira. Mudzalandira zikumbutso, mawu a chikumbutso, ndi chikwangwani mankhwala akafika.

ai.title: Kuwunika kwa AI Pavidiyo
ai.content: Lumikizani kamera (kuphatikiza Dahua IP) kapena kwezani mavidiyo. YOLOv8 imawerenga nkhuku, kuzitsata, ndikuzindikira kubundikira kapena khalidwe lachilendo nthawi yomweyo.

audio.title: Kusanthula Mawu a Nkhuku
audio.content: Jambulani mawu a khola ndi maikolofoni. Dongosolo limamvetsera kutsokomola, kuyatsimula ndi mawu a mavuto kuti matenda a kupuma adziwike asanafalikire.

analytics.title: Zowerengera ndi Malipoti
analytics.content: Onani momwe chakudya chikusinthira kukhala kulemera, imfa, kukula ndi momwe magulu akugwirira ntchito ndi ma chati osavuta kuyerekeza.

financial.title: Nzeru za Ndalama
financial.content: Tsatirani ndalama zolowa ndi zotuluka, onani phindu pa gulu lililonse, ndipo gwiritsani ntchito kuyerekeza ndalama kukonza malonda. Lipoti la PDF lili pafupi.

settings.title: Zosintha za Famu
settings.content: Sinthani zambiri za famu, malo ndi mwayi wa gulu lanu pano.

done.title: Mwakonzeka!
done.content: Famu yonse ili pamalo amodzi. Mutha kubwereza ulendo uwu nthawi iliyonse ndi batani la "Yambitsanso Ulendo Ofotokoza" pansi pa sidebar.
